# glossary

The Bite Platform as the release meeting talks about it: the environments, what is published to them, and who owns which word.

| Term | Definition |
|---|---|
| Environment | System: Platform. One installation of the Bite Platform, with its own data. |
| Build | System: Pipeline. The zip the pipeline produces, one per commit that passes the gate. |
| Release | Extends Build. A build the release manager has signed off. |
| Changelog | System: Docs. Similar to Build. |
| Award | |
